title: Camp Wannakumbac

services.name: 2026 Summer Camp
services.desc: Online Registration for the Summer Camp 2026 is Now Open - Secure Your Spot Today! Wannakumbac's Summer Camp program provides a 7- day, 6-night co-ed experience for campers (ages 8 to 15). Camp has provided a creative, educational, and unique social experience for young people from all backgrounds and cultures from across Manitoba and beyond for over 75 years. For youth (Ages 16+), we have offered Counsellor In Training Leadership Development programs for almost 30 years! Wannakumbac is a non-denominational camp, owned by The Clear Lake Community Service Cooperative Inc. Est. 2024, which is non-profit, and ensures that camper fees are lowest possible. services.desc: Online Registration for the Summer Camp 2026 is Now Open - Secure Your Spot Today! Our newest cabin, built in 2007, is a humble abode nestled on the west shore of the crystal waters of Clear Lake. The cabin is situated on Camp Wannakumbac grounds, bordering Riding Mountain National Park and just a short walk away from the water. During your stay enjoy exploring one of the many trails here at camp or in the park. Take some time to unplug and get out in nature, as there is limited wifi and cell service (depending on your provider).
